sciencedb

The goal of sciencedb is to provide a user-friendly, programmatic R interface to ScienceDB (Science Data Bank), a global generalist data repository managed by the Computer Network Information Center (CNIC) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS). As a core platform for publishing, sharing, and accessing scientific data from China and around the world, ScienceDB holds vast, high-value datasets spanning multidisciplinary research domains.

sciencedb bridges this ecosystem with R workflow by allowing users to search across up to 10,000 datasets by keywords, inspect dataset metadata, and batch-downloads files directly into their local environment with smart file management.

Installation

You can install the development version of sciencedb from GitHub with:

# Recommended (fast installer)
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("jennyyzxu/sciencedb")

Example

Below is a basic example demonstrating how an R user can aery multi-word topics, evaluate dataset structure, and download data files locally:

library(sciencedb)

  1. Search for Datasets

    Use sdb_search() to discover datasets using keywords. Because queries return deep multi-column metadata, fetching queries across thousands of records can take 15 to 30 seconds depending on network latency. The function returns a cleaned data frame where each row represents a dataset and includes 12 metadata attributes:

    Column Description
    Title Primary English dataset title (falls back to Chinese title if English is absent)
    Author Semicolon-separated list of author names
    Keyword Semicolon-separated domain keywords
    Publish Official dataset release date
    Doi Digital Object Identifier associated with the dataset
    Taxonomy Scientific classification and subject taxonomy
    Language Primary dataset language code (en, zh, etc.)
    Introduction Full dataset abstract and methodological description
    Access Rights/conditions (PUBLIC, RESTRICTED, or EMBARGO)
    Views Historical platform page view counts
    Downloads Total file download metric
    Cstr China Science and Technology Resource identifier 
# Search for datasets related to attachment
results <- sdb_search(keyword = "attachment")

# Preview core metadata columns 
head(results)

  1. Inspect Dataset Details

    Once a dataset or DOI of inerest is identified from the search results, use sdb_dive() to pull full file lists, directory hierarchies, and version details:

# Retreive full metadata and file information for a specific dataset
info <- sdb_dive(doi = "10.57760/sciencedb.o00115.00098")

# Preview dataset-relevant research paper
info[[1]]$papers

  1. Download Files

    Use sdb_download() to download dataset files to your local directory. The function automatically rename files (e.g., data(1).csv) if duplicates exist:

# Download all files into a local folder
sdb_download(
  doi = "10.57760/sciencedb.o00115.00098",
  user_path = "~/Desktop"
)
#> Found 3 file(s) to download.
#> [1/3] Downloading: meta-analysis_av.cma ...
#> [2/3] Downloading: meta-analysis_ax.cma ...
#> [3/3] Downloading: power calculation.R ...
#> All downloads completed successfully!
